# Mare Lento

> Official multilingual website for Mare Lento, a holiday apartment for up to four guests in Falerna Marina, Calabria, Italy.

## Official pages

- [Italian](https://marelentocalabria.it/): Official Italian version and default page.
- [English](https://marelentocalabria.it/en/): Official English version.
- [Polish](https://marelentocalabria.it/pl/): Official Polish version.
- [German](https://marelentocalabria.it/de/): Official German version.
- [French](https://marelentocalabria.it/fr/): Official French version.
- [Spanish](https://marelentocalabria.it/es/): Official Spanish version.

## Accommodation and availability

- [Apartment and gallery](https://marelentocalabria.it/#apartament): Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living and dining area, compact kitchen, air conditioning and balcony.
- [Availability and stay enquiry](https://marelentocalabria.it/#dostepnosc): Guests select check-in, check-out and up to four guests. An enquiry does not block dates until the owner accepts it.
- [Calabria area guide](https://marelentocalabria.it/#okolica): Visitor information for Falerna Marina and selected destinations on the Tyrrhenian coast.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://marelentocalabria.it/#faq): Booking, apartment layout, location and contact answers.

## Location and privacy

Mare Lento is located in Falerna Marina, 88042 Calabria, Italy. The exact street address and arrival directions are shared after a stay is confirmed.
